# Cost, Limits and Resilience Checklist: Critical Thinking Questions on Writing Posts

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the token bucket, refund, 429 messaging, model fallback, free-allowance and cache requirements
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [research.md](../research.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test whether the requirements are complete, clear, consistent and measurable; they do not test the implementation.

## Bucket Semantics

- [ ] CHK001 Is "refills over time to a daily allowance" defined as a capacity, a refill rate and a refill model (continuous versus daily reset), with one stated formula? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the initial bucket state specified for a new environment and after a database replacement (full, empty or seeded)? [Gap, Data model §3]
- [ ] CHK003 Are concurrent-request semantics defined so simultaneous presses cannot take more tokens than the bucket holds? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Is "about 200 generations a day" resolved to an exact default number in one place, and do spec, plan and research agree on it? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the cost of one token (one generation, regardless of input size) stated, and are first generation and "new questions" treated identically? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it specified that a cache hit takes no token and performs no bucket write? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK007 Are configuration validation requirements stated (bad capacity or refill values fail clearly rather than silently disabling the limit)? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]

## Refunds and Failure Handling

- [ ] CHK008 Is the refund rule decided and stated for every failure class (model error, timeout, malformed output, D1 write failure, asset read failure)? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the spec's "decided in the plan" deferral on failed-attempt usage resolved identically in plan, research and contract? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK010 Are refund limits defined so a refund can never push the bucket above capacity? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the behaviour defined when the refund itself fails? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 Is a model timeout value specified, and is it compatible with the 5-second success target? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK013 Is retry guidance for the reader on 503 defined (immediate retry allowed, or any back-off), given retries consume tokens only on success? [Gap, Contract §Q09]

## 429 Messaging

- [ ] CHK014 Is `retryAfter` defined as the time until at least one token is available, with rounding rules, and is `Retry-After` consistent with the body field? [Clarity, Contract §Q08]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the visible 429 message rounding rules (minutes, hours above 90 minutes, minimum value) unambiguous at both ends of the range? [Clarity, Contract §P15]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it specified that a limited response on a cached post is impossible (cache served first) and that the ordering of cache check versus bucket check is fixed? [Consistency, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "roughly when to try again" measurable, with a tolerance? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-020]

## Model Choice and Fallback

- [ ] CHK018 Is the fallback model, the trigger for switching and its changed bucket size named, and is the switch a config-only change? [Completeness, Research §R1, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for the model being deprecated, renamed or unavailable in the account (a distinct failure from a transient error)? [Gap, Research §R1]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the question-quality bar stated so a model swap can be judged (what makes a set acceptable beyond the validator)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the output length cap (`max_tokens`) reconciled with the maximum of 4 questions of about 25 words? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Research §R1]

## Free Allowance and Cost

- [ ] CHK022 Is the free-allowance arithmetic stated with sources and dates (neurons per generation, neurons per day, the account-wide shared allowance across environments)? [Traceability, Spec §FR-024, Research §R1]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the combined production and preview usage required to fit the allowance, with a stated rule for raising either bucket? [Completeness, Plan §Risks]
- [ ] CHK024 Is behaviour specified for the account's free allocation being exhausted by something other than this site's own buckets (provider-side refusal mapped to a user-facing state)? [Gap, Plan §Constitution Check IX]
- [ ] CHK025 Are D1 read and write volumes per request bounded and checked against free-plan row limits? [Measurability, Constitution §VIII]
- [ ] CHK026 Is a monitoring or alerting requirement stated (aggregate counts only) so Don can see usage approach the ceiling? [Gap, Spec §FR-022]

## Cache and Invalidation

- [ ] CHK027 Is the cache key defined precisely (slug plus SHA-256 of which fields: title, summary, body, front matter) and are non-content changes (styling, unrelated fields) specified as not invalidating it? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, Research §R3]
- [ ] CHK028 Is it specified whether "new questions" replaces, adds to, or never touches the cached set, with one answer in spec, plan and contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, Contract §Q12]
- [ ] CHK029 Are stale-set requirements defined: superseded versions are never served, and their removal or retention is stated? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the hash-mismatch case (page built before an edit, Worker deployed after) covered with defined reader-facing behaviour? [Edge Case, Contract §Q07]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the behaviour defined when two readers trigger first generation of the same post version simultaneously (duplicate generation, single token or two)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 Are the cache-miss path and database-replacement path consistent: an empty cache after migration is a valid state with no data loss? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025]
